notes.title: Update notes for Patch 2
notes.content:
We have further performance improvements ready for you.

After a thorough process of improving the process of Evershire we are happy to announce we've achieved up to 30% performance improvements on larger levels.

We've made progress on improvements on both the CPU and GPU and are continuously working on improving the performance further.

[b]Changes:[/b]
Visual changes to the wind turbine have been made in preparation for more customization options on the wind turbine.

notes.title: Update notes for Patch 1
notes.content:
We have a few fixes ready for all of you, below is a list of what was changed in this version.

[b]Fixes[/b]:
* 40-Tiles Lake achievement can now be achieved
* Building placement achievements now work again
* Score achievements now work again
* Decorations can be rotated during modification
* Details of decorations now properly follow the structure when being moved
* Details of decorations no longer stay blue after failing to move a decoration
* Details of the windmill now don't randomize every time the underlying tile changes
* Decoration modify rotation is now smoothed
* Fixed tutorial widgets overlaying the structure placement popup
* Fixed tutorial widgets not being centered in the screen on widescreens
* Fixed card rewards overlaying the tutorial widgets
* Fixed tutorial widgets being visible during preset creation
* Fixed typos in the German localization

[b]Improvements[/b]:
We have performed a large optimization pass to ensure that framerate remains stable when many buildings and decorations with rotating/moving elements are placed.

[b]Changes[/b]:
Animal movement (except hopping in place) is currently disabled due to the severe performance impact the moving animals have on the CPU. We are working on a solution to this and will push an update in the future where animal movement is re-enabled when the performance aspect is taken care of.
